Description: Los Angeles is the largest city in California and the seat of Los Angeles County, with about 3.88 million residents across 470.5 square miles of land. It has a Mediterranean climate with dry summers and a wet winter season, and pronounced microclimates: the coastal basin runs cooler (Koppen Csb) than inland valleys such as the San Fernando Valley (Csa).
